description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Do hereby revoke, rescind and cancel the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2356/43 dated 25.11.2023 (there by the Interim Committee dissolved)
reasoning: This gazette content involves the revocation and cancellation of a previous gazette notification under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973. It deals with legal/regulatory matters - specifically the exercise of statutory powers under existing legislation to rescind a previous legal notice and dissolve an interim committee. While a minister is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about exercising legal authority under a specific act.
